case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests repeatedly praise the hotel's location and sea views, the gardens and cliff-top setting, spacious rooms or bungalows with private outdoor areas, friendly staff and generous breakfasts; several guests even extended stays. Criticisms cite aging rooms and bedding, inconsistent cleanliness, uneven pool maintenance (cold/unheated, crowded or not cleaned), neglected grounds and garden care, occasional cold showers, and limited direct beach access.

review_summary_metadata.summary_method: Neutral LLM summary of the frozen recent review sample; no additional reviews retrieved.

priorities.recommendation: Run room audit; immediately replace/repair beds, provide toppers, fix windows/appliances, phased CAPEX prioritizing guest/complaint rooms.

priorities.area: Pool & outdoor-area upkeep and guest experience
priorities.recommendation: Deep-clean/test pools immediately; establish/document daily maintenance; repair sunbeds/parasols (most-used); review guest-flow; assess pool-heating feasibility/business case.
Inspect hot-water systems/rooms; prioritize repairs, log complaints, inform check-in guests, offer room changes when available.

priorities.area: Bathroom condition / hot water and sanitary maintenance
priorities.recommendation: Inspect hot-water-supply and pressure/temperature-controls; log affected-rooms, repair, offer remediation per guest-relations-policy; assess system if intermittent/systemic.
Review pricing and value positioning, evaluate alignment with amenities, consider messaging, perform value-assessment before adjustments.

priorities.area: Room condition and grounds (mattresses, dated furnishings, garden maintenance)
priorities.recommendation: Commission systematic assessment of representative rooms and grounds to prioritize refurbishment; implement interim fixes where feasible.
